stem: A dashboard shows 60% RH in two rooms, but one room is warmer. Which action best preserves useful environmental evidence?
choices: Record each room's temperature and RH pair and use the supplied method to interpret VPD for each room.
Treat the rooms as having the same VPD because their RH percentages match.
Lower RH in the warmer room until the displayed percentages differ enough to show a VPD difference.
Use RH alone because temperature affects plant growth but not atmospheric drying demand.
rationale: Relative humidity cannot be interpreted independently of temperature when assessing atmospheric drying demand. Two rooms can both read 60% RH yet have different vapor-pressure relationships because the warmer room has a different saturation vapor pressure. The strongest record preserves the paired temperature/RH measurements for each room and then applies the facility's approved interpretation method rather than assuming equal VPD from equal RH.
